newsitem.title: INDIA: Philippines' Ramos to visit India in March.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos to visit India in March.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos will arrive in India on March 2 on a four-day official visit, an Indian government spokesman said on Tuesday.
Ramos, the first Filipino president ever to visit India, will be accompanied by a delegation of senior businessmen and government officials, the United News of India said.
Ramos is scheduled to meet Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda, President Shankar Dayal Sharma and Vice-President Kocheril Raman Narayanan during his visit, the news agency said.
